text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Hurry! Hurry, let's get to 
training!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I was so close to first place, Boss! I've 
gotta get way stronger before the next 
race!
choice_data_list: It's okay, you ran a great race.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I definitely gave it everything I had 
and put up a heated fight!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That's precisely why... it makes me want 
to, like... run straight toward the 
sun...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Gwaaaah! I can't take it anymore! I'm 
going for a run by the riverbank!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Huh?!! But there's no way I can sit still 
like that, ya know~~!
choice_data_list:
If you don't look back, you'll just make 
the same mistake again

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ugh... That's gonna be a real problem...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Understood! I'll listen while doing muscle 
training, so hit me with it, Trainer!
